pages.text: Aether wells endlessly from the violet-and-black squares, as though their rules never included an ending. It continually supplies adjacent devices.

pages.title: Observe a complete flow
pages.text: Obtain it from the creative inventory; there is no crafting recipe. Supply a reservoir, then an emitter or resonance tree, and watch where your flow branches or stops.$(br2)The source never dries, but each device along the path still has its own throughput.
